mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT cc.* FROM biz_course_category cc JOIN biz_course_template ct ON ct.course_category_id = cc.id JOIN biz_course_detail cd ON cd.course_template_id = ct.id WHERE cc.remove_flag = 0 AND ct.remove_flag = 0 AND cd.remove_flag = 0 AND cd.course_master_id = #{courseMasterId}
SELECT DISTINCT cc.* FROM biz_course_category cc WHERE cc.remove_flag = 0 AND cc.major = #{major}
